mapper.sql: a.achievement_id, a.management_no, a.teacher_user_id, COALESCE(k.name, u.login_id) AS teacher_name, a.organization_code, a.evaluation_year, a.management_item_code, a.achievement_date, d.performance_detail, a.achievement_status, a.attachment_ids::text AS attachment_ids, a.created_at, a.updated_at

FROM education_achievements a JOIN course_operation_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id LEFT JOIN korus_personnel_snapshots k ON k.employee_no = u.employee_no
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT k.organization_code FROM users u JOIN korus_personnel_snapshots k ON k.employee_no = u.employee_no WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND k.status = 'ACTIVE'), (SELECT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND m.effective_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND (m.effective_end_date IS NULL OR m.effective_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY m.effective_start_date DESC, m.mapping_id DESC LIMIT 1) )
SELECT u.user_id FROM users u WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.setting_id FROM input_period_settings p WHERE p.evaluation_year = #{year} AND p.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND p.active_yn = 'Y' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP BETWEEN p.start_at AND p.end_at AND ( p.organization_code IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.organization_code = p.organization_code AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' ) ) ORDER BY p.setting_id FOR SHARE

SELECT m.teacher_editable_yn, m.required_yn, m.data_type FROM evaluation_management_items m JOIN evaluation_elements e ON e.element_id = m.element_id JOIN evaluation_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id JOIN evaluation_areas a ON a.area_id = i.area_id JOIN evaluation_rule_versions v ON v.rule_version_id = a.rule_version_id WHERE m.management_item_code = #{code} AND e.evaluation_year = #{year} AND e.element_code = 'FR-030' AND a.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND m.active_yn = 'Y' AND e.active_yn = 'Y' AND i.active_yn = 'Y' AND a.active_yn = 'Y' AND v.version_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND v.effective_start_date <= (#{year} || '-12-31')::date AND v.effective_end_date >= (#{year} || '-01-01')::date ORDER BY m.management_item_id FOR SHARE OF m, e, i, a, v
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements a SET management_item_code = #{code}, achievement_date = #{date}, achievement_detail = CAST(#{detailJson} AS jsonb), attachment_ids = CAST(#{attachmentsJson} AS jsonb), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId} WHERE a.achievement_id = #{id} AND a.achievement_type = 'FR-030' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N' AND a.teacher_user_id = #{userId} AND a.achievement_status IN ('DRAFT', 'DEPARTMENT_REJECTED', 'CERTIFICATION_REJECTED') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_finalizations f WHERE f.target_user_id = a.teacher_user_id AND f.evaluation_year = a.evaluation_year AND f.final_status = 'EVALUATION_CONFIRMED' )
mapper.select: SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('achievement', TO_JSONB(a), 'detail', TO_JSONB(d))::text FROM education_achievements a JOIN course_operation_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id WHERE a.achievement_id = #{id} AND a.achievement_type = 'FR-030'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO education_achievement_status_histories ( achievement_type, achievement_id, previous_status, next_status, action_type, opinion, processed_by ) VALUES ('FR-030', #{id}, NULL, 'DRAFT', 'CREATE', '강좌 개설·운영 실적 최초 입력', #{userId})
